📝 Summary
## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * End-to-end test runs can now use custom ScyllaDB, Manager, and Manager Agent image references across supported environments. * Targeted runs support optional names for clearer run identification and allow differently named runs on the same branch to proceed independently. * ScyllaDB update and upgrade tests can select suitable earlier images from available repository tags. * **Changes** * Kind test runs use a fixed suite timeout; the parallelism and timeout inputs are no longer available. * ScyllaDB update and upgrade test versions are no longer configured in the project settings. E2E workflows now accept optional ScyllaDB, Manager, and Manager Agent image references and pass them to runners. Installation scripts validate and apply supplied references. Test options use image references and can discover update-from and upgrade-from versions from repository tags. Upgrade tests and fixtures now use the updated image-reference fields. The fixed ScyllaDB test-version configuration and its synchronization script were removed. ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant TestCommand participant RunOptions participant ImageTagUtilities participant DockerRegistry TestCommand->>RunOptions: Complete test options RunOptions->>ImageTagUtilities: Parse target and select source versions ImageTagUtilities->>DockerRegistry: List repository tags DockerRegistry-->>ImageTagUtilities: Return tags ImageTagUtilities-->>RunOptions: Return selected image references RunOptions-->>TestCommand: Continue with completed options ```
Priority: Normal **Change:** Feature
Merge Risk: Moderate · up to d2be0
A registry outage can now prevent unrelated E2E suites from running. Limit discovery to affected suites or handle discovery failures without aborting unrelated tests before merging.

test/e2e/utils/scylladb_versions_test.go: 1
`130-148`: ** Trivial** · **Maintainability & Code Quality** · **Poor tradeoff** **Add a success-path test for `ListImageRepositoryTags`.** `TestListImageRepositoryTagsRejectsNonRepositories` passes whenever `ListImageRepositoryTags` returns an error for the four invalid inputs. It does not check a returned tag list. A registry call that fails for every input would still pass this test. No test covers a valid repository. Default source-image discovery in `pkg/cmd/tests/tests_run.go` calls this path when the update and upgrade image refs are unset. A regression in that path would not fail the unit suite. An e2e run may still catch it, depending on how CI sets those refs. `ListImageRepositoryTags` calls `docker.GetRepositoryTags` directly and has no injectable registry client. A success-path test therefore needs either network access or a refactor that injects the client.

** Major** · **Stability & Availability** · **Quick win**


**Run registry discovery only for suites that contain update or upgrade specs.**

`Complete` returns on a failed Docker Hub tag listing before any spec runs. Suites without update or upgrade specs fail on an outage they do not use. Logging the error keeps those suites running. Update and upgrade specs then skip, as they already do when refs are empty.
